content:
The data here runs to 2026-03-27 — 77 days ago — so treat these as a snapshot, not a live picture.

The single biggest slice of tracked spend is **housing** at £2,180, nearly half of everything recorded. Within that, one transaction stands out: £820 to Sublet — Bermondsey on 4 February, the largest single charge in the window. **Entertainment** is the next notable category at £540 across the period, running at roughly £198 a month — that's the line with the most room to move.

Only 8 transactions sit behind this read, so patterns are thin. What's clear is that fixed costs are anchored at £743 a month, and the trailing average of free cash flow is £2,157 a month — though income is variable and swings, so that average can flatter any given month.

On the runway goal: £7,600 still to go toward £9,600. The monthly pace needed to get there on time isn't calculable yet — because there's no target date. That one input is what unlocks the goal math entirely.

[CTA:supply_input]Set a target date for 3-month runway[/CTA]

— C.
